tools.name: get_market_metadata
tools.description: Get metadata for active tweet/post-count markets (elon, cruz, or trump): market IDs, questions and live counters. Needs a Polystrike Data key (X-API-Key header on the MCP request).

tools.name: get_crypto_metadata
tools.description: Get metadata for crypto markets. No authentication required. Returns market IDs and basic crypto market info.

tools.name: get_recent_tweets
tools.description: Get recent posts for elon/cruz (X tweets) or trump (Truth Social), up to 100 per page with the is_counted flag. Needs a Polystrike Data key (X-API-Key header on the MCP request).

tools.name: get_predictions
tools.description: Get the counters and Polymarket bucket prices for active tweet/post-count markets (elon, cruz, or trump). Data only: no forecasts or trading signals. Needs a Polystrike Data key (X-API-Key header on the MCP request).

tools.name: check_health
tools.description: Check Polystrike API health status. No authentication required. Use for debugging or verifying API availability.

findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_market_metadata, get_recent_tweets, get_predictions · Public sink: get_market_metadata, get_predictions.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_market_metadata, get_recent_tweets, get_predictions · Public sink: get_market_metadata, get_predictions

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "get_market_metadata" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.

evidence.snippet: before: "Get metadata for active tweet/post-count markets (elon, cruz, or trump). No authentication required. FREE counts are ~5 min delayed. Returns market IDs, questions, and counters." → after: "Get metadata for active tweet/post-count markets (elon, cruz, or trump): market IDs, questions and live counters. Needs a Polystrike Data key (X-API-Key header on the MCP request)."

findings.remediation: Re-review the tool before continuing to trust it.
